story: Iris sold the real lens prisms and set plain glass in their place.
Hollis counted the lens and found the fake panel. He told her he would ask her at ten.
Iris followed him up at ten and struck him with the brass bar from her workshop.
She hid the bar, took the stairs down soon after, and went back to the workshop.

deductions.claim: Iris was in the tower, though she says she never left the ground floor.
Hollis found the swapped prism and Iris had sold the real ones.
One blow with a narrow bar, no fall and no poison.
